newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, June 24 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none due. Max. recommended draft 26 ft. 11 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none due. Max. recommended draft 26 ft. 11 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Six vessels berthed of which 3 loading sbmp, 1 loading sun pellets, 1 loading sbo, 1 discharging naphtha. 10 Vessels in roads, 29 due at 6 terminals during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising approx. 0.15 metres during next week. Pasa berth draft 21 ft. 1 in. Fw.

Rosario - Nine vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 3 discharging fertiliser, 1 discharging steel billets, 1 loading wheat, 1 under repair, 1 loading fruit, 1 loading sbo. 2 Vessels in roads, 12 due during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising approx. 0.15 metres during next week. Villa Constitucion - One vessel loading wrc. 1 Vessel in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. Fw. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging steel products, 1 discharging steel pipes, 1 awaiting orders. No vessels in roads. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising approx. 0.15 metres during next week.

San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 1 due. San Lorenzo - Rosario, San Nicolas, San Pedro - Max. draft 32 ft. 6 in./33 ft. 0 in. Fw. at high tide. Buenos Aires - 18 Vessels in port, 20 due during the week. Max. recommendable draft 31 ft. 6 in. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud max. recommendable draft 28/29 ft. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 2 loading maize, 1 discharging dap, 1 loading sunflower, 1 loading fish. 13 Vessels in roads, 17 due during the week. On 23/6 the authorities informed a new determinant of 28 ft. 10 in. Ft/bw at zero level (100 metres wide) for vessels up to 190 metres loa. Therefore max. recommendable sailing draft with high tide is 40 ft. 0 in. Fw/bw. Vessels with loa over 190 metres cannot enter/sail until new soundings are carried out.

Bahia Blanca - Seven vessels berthed of which 1 loading crude, 3 loading maize, 1 discharging barley, 1 loading sfp/sbp, 1 discharging urea. 2 Vessels in roads, 12 due during the week, draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, June 24 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 2 bulk wheat dischargers, 1 sugar loader, 2 containers/general cargo loaders/dischargers, 1 iron ore loader, 1 malt discharger, 1 trucks discharger. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - 2 Cellulose dischargers. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader. 10 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 11 full container loaders/dischargers, 1 bulk cement, 3 bulk chemical products loaders/dischargers, 1 bulk lpg discharger, 5 fertiliser dischargers, 9 sugar loaders, 1 bulk juice loader, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 bulk sulphur loader, 1 heavy load discharger, 1 bulk vegetable oil discharger, 2 pellets loaders. 15 Vessels waiting in roads, 68 due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Bulk coal discharger, 1 iron ore discharger, 2 steel products loaders. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk sulphur discharger. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed - 2 Container loaders, 3 soya loaders, 2 soyabean loaders, 1 acid discharger, 2 fertiliser dischargers. 4 Vessels waiting in roads, 21 due during next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 2 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 1 container discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 2 steel products loaders. Tecon - 3 Vessels, 41 due. Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 fertiliser discharger, 3 general cargo dischargers, 4 sugar loaders, 1 pellets loader, 2 soya loaders, 3 general cargo loaders. 16 Vessels waiting in roads of which for loading, 7 sugar, 1 reefer, 2 pellets, 3 soya. For discharging, 3 fertiliser. 25 Vessels due. Sao Sebastiao - Three vessels berthed at Tebar, 4 waiting in roads, 3 due.

COLOMBIA, June 24 - Barranquilla - Vessels berthed, 1 bulker, 2 general cargo, no vessels anchored. Vessels due, 2 bulkers, 7 containers, 8 general. Waiting time, bulkers 1 day, general cargo 1 day. Cartagena - Vessels berthed, 1 bulker, 2 containers, no vessels anchored. Vessels due, 1 bulker, 10 containers, 8 general cargo, 1 days waiting time for general cargo vessels. Santa Marta - Vessels berthed, 1 container, 4 general cargo, 1 bulker anchored. 5 Container vessels due, no waiting time. Buenaventura - Vessels berthed, 2 bulkers, 2 containers, 1 general cargo, 1 bulker anchored. Vessels due, 4 bulkers, 14 container vessels, 3 general cargo, 2 pcc. Waiting time, bulkers 2 days, containers 1 day, general cargo 1 day.

PERU, June 23 - Callao - Seven vessels in bay, 10 in pier (general cargo/containers). No berthing delays. Paita - One fishmeal vessel in pier. No berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels. Talara - Two vessels in bay, 1 in pier, no berthing delays. Chimbote - Three vessels in bay, 4 in pier (fishmeal). No berthing Delays.

VENEZUELA, June 23 - Puerto Cabello - Six vessels anchored. 11 Vessels berthed of which 7 grain, 1 general cargo, 1 ro/ro, 1 container vessel. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Pier platforms 25, 26, 27, 29 being repaved since 2/6. Work is estimated to last for 90 days. Piers flagstone 8, 9, 10, 11 being changed. Work is estimated to last 45 days. Guanta - Two vessels anchored. 6 Vessels berthed of which 1 grain, 4 bulk cargo, 1 container vessel.
